criterion: 十二組欄位及適用子表可呈現，已有資料以 ID 引用且不存在平行手寫來源；修改來源後可重新產生一致文件。未知／不適用／計畫／實作／驗證狀態可區別，刻意製造設計與程式差異不能僅因文件完整而通過。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Manifest IDs populate the 12 module groups; generated output changes with the source. Required finding for the counterexample: Unknown facts presented as verified, parallel editable ownership tables, or missing implementation evidence fail the design contract/review.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
